text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian
did not show up for training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went looking for her,
I spotted a familiar silhouette at the local bathhouse...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
That was a nice bath.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
For an exceptional bath like this,
I gotta pair it with this bad boy...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, irresistible.
It permeates right through to my very core.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Trainer?
What are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Did I soak for too long?
...My apologies."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave Narita Brian a firm warning
to be careful from now on...
